from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.

kept.says: How its parts stand, where not each on those before it: by time, as a day's words or a history's stories, kept in the order they came and not numbered.

parts.says: The briefs beneath, in order, each standing on those before it.

prose.says: The understanding itself, in markdown. A link standing alone in a paragraph places a part there; a link in a sentence only mentions.

status.says: Where the brief stands, when it is not yet in force, as proposed.

title.says: The heading: the understanding in a few words.

body.says: One piece of prose giving one understanding, under the rule: its face is its title and first paragraph, and what stands beneath it, its parts, are briefs in the order each stands on those before.
body.title: Brief
